AI code review results below, please doublecheck

Some concerns, see inline comments. The fix is correct for the .lustre/fid case but the identical leak in the sibling .lustre branch of the same function is left in place. It would also be good to add a regression test (repeat llapi_open_by_fid_at()/open_by_handle_at() on the .lustre and .lustre/fid FIDs, then unmount and check the client does not report busy inodes).

commit.subject: LU-20545 llite: fix inode ref leak on cached .lustre/fid
commit.message:
LU-20545 llite: fix inode ref leak on cached .lustre/fid

In ll_iget_for_nfs(), when opening a special FID under .lustre,
the code takes an inode reference via search_inode_for_lustre(),
then looks up an existing dentry with d_lookup().
If the dentry is already cached, the reference should be dropped,
otherwise each hit of this path leaks one inode ref until the client
is unmounted or the inode is forced out some other way.

Fixes: 52a97b4490 ("LU-8585 llite: add special fid handling for fhandle API")
Signed-off-by: Emoly Liu <emoly@whamcloud.com>
Change-Id: Iff979da0e77245d5f37c50e63f9efc676c4e8502
